_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Design Analysis Report
summary: Describes the format, content, and intended use for a report evaluating the design approach and compliance of a configuration item, system, subsystem, or Schedule Replaceable Assembly for government visibility.
use_relationship:
This report is used to evaluate the design approach and compliance for the configuration item, system, subsystem, and Schedule Replaceable Assemblies and to provide visibility to the government. The data may also be used to formulate additional technical direction to the design activity. This report is normally prepared during the analysis effort for each configuration item or subsystem during system acquisition. It may also be applicable to other developmental efforts

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work/Performance Work Statement.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be structured to cover each of the major subsections of the design analysis task separately. The analysis report shall correlate the design requirements with the system requirement and any specified requirement for the subsystem or configuration item. The report shall describe or reference all related data (sketches, preliminary drawings, schematics, functional diagrams) necessary for portrayal of the analysis or to aid in an understanding of the analysis.

children.title: The Design Analysis Report shall be organized into the following sections
Scope
children.content: This section shall be divided into the following sub-sections:

children.title: Description of the items involved
children.content: Description of the items involved, including adequate drawings, schematics, and embedded digital graphics, to support the analysis;

children.title: Specification of design constraints and assumptions imposed on the analysis
Discussion of the evaluation and analysis procedure, method, or technique used
children.content: Discussion of the evaluation and analysis procedure, method, or technique used, and its probable accuracy with an estimate of uncertainty, explained by calculations;

children.title: Identification of source material used in the analysis
Results of the analysis
children.content: Results of the analysis, to include the following:

children.title: Design impact and any constraints which influence other subsystems or configuration items
Problems encountered or revealed, and suggested solutions
Document design compliance to technical requirements
Detail compliance to military and industry design specification guidance
Identify where design does not comply with military and industry design specification guidance
